FX-SHIFT-001.says: The settings as they start, alpha from alpha, red from red, green from green, blue from blue: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SHIFT-002.says: Red from blue and blue from red, the two swapped: the red swatch turns blue, #2828c8, the blue turns #ff6040, the skin a pale blue, #bed6f6; every grey stays as it is, and every covering is kept.

FX-SHIFT-003.says: Red, green and blue all from green: each pixel turns the grey of its own green: the red #282828, the green #b4b4b4, the skin #d6d6d6.

FX-SHIFT-004.says: Red, green and blue from luminance: each pixel turns the grey of its encoded luma, 0.2126 red + 0.7152 green + 0.0722 blue: the red 74.016 of 255, the green 147.268; white, grey and black stay as they are.

FX-SHIFT-005.says: Red, green and blue from hue: each pixel turns the grey of its HSV hue, a full turn the whole scale: the red, at 0 degrees, turns black, the green (130 degrees) 92.08 of 255, the blue (229.95 degrees) 162.88 and the skin (25.71 degrees) 18.21; a grey has no hue and turns black.

FX-SHIFT-006.says: Red, green and blue from lightness, the middle of the largest and the smallest channel: the red 120 of 255, the skin 218, the blue 159.5; every grey stays as it is.

FX-SHIFT-007.says: Red, green and blue from saturation, HSL's: the red two thirds of the scale (170), the green half (127.5), the blue the whole; every grey has none and turns black.

FX-SHIFT-008.says: Red full, green half and blue off: every pixel that shows turns orange, full red and green at half of the encoded scale (127.5), its covering kept, so the soft edges are orange at half covering.

FX-SHIFT-009.says: Alpha from luminance, the Colorful Glitch tutorial's use: the dark parts drop out: the black is gone, the white stays, the grey shows at 128 of 255, the red at 74.016, the line at 27.57; a soft edge's covering is its colour's luma, so the soft line is as faint as the line and the soft skin as strong as the skin.

FX-SHIFT-010.says: Alpha full: everything shows, at full covering: the empty border turns black, and the soft edges turn solid line and solid skin.

FX-SHIFT-012.says: Alpha half: everything shows at half covering, the empty border black at half, the soft edges no fainter than the rest.

FX-SHIFT-013.says: Red, green and blue from alpha: the covering as grey: the drawing white, its soft edges a half grey (128 of 255) at half covering, the border still empty.

FX-SHIFT-014.says: Alpha from saturation: every grey drops out, the blue stays whole, the red shows at two thirds and the green at half.

FX-SHIFT-015.says: All four at once: red from hue, green from saturation, blue from lightness and alpha from luminance, the swatches seen as HSL over their brightness.

FX-SHIFT-016.says: FX-SHIFT-009 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SHIFT-017.says: Red from "Full": the words are lower case. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHIFT-018.says: Alpha from "yes", not a word Shift Channels takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHIFT-019.says: Green from "brightness": this program's word is "luminance". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHIFT-020.says: Blue from "", no word at all. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
